title: 2.5d workflow for prototyping games with Astra
author: hyp3rclaw

comments.author: Reign2294
comments.body: The real problem is, it looks like every cheap AI art out there. You really can do better, even with local models. Research your art styles and try to recreate what you have in a consistent unique art style. String, voxel, types of animation, etc. Best advice I can give.

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body: Thanks appreciate the feedback! will work on it

replies.author: Reign2294
replies.body: The workflow shouldn't be too hard. You already have the prompts, yes? Now just add a style block to them and recreate them in better quality using a set style.

replies.author: crumbaker
replies.body: This looks better than 95%  of what's being shown in this sub.

replies.author: Reign2294
replies.body: You're right! It is decent. I have seen far too many people selling AI children's books and this art style gives me that vibe. It may be decently polished, but the style leans AI moreso than not to me.

comments.author: odragora
comments.body: Looks great, but it would be great to actually see the workflow.

replies.author: hyp3rclaw
replies.body: Thanks it was generating lots of images for ideation , then creating a platformer mvp that evolved into this
